title: fix_signal.prompt missing Reviewer, Moderator, and QA Architect persona sections
description: fix_signal.rs does not load reviewer, moderator, or qa-architect roles, and fix_signal.prompt has no corresponding persona sections. The Per-Step Review Sub-Loop in fix_signal.skill.md references the Reviewer Persona and Moderator Persona inline, but they are absent from the rendered fix_signal.prompt, making the review sub-loop non-functional. This run added the Reasoning Reviewer Persona but exposed the pre-existing gap for the other three personas.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to extend fix_signal.rs to load reviewer, moderator, and qa-architect roles and inject them into fix_signal.prompt alongside the reasoning_reviewer_persona, mirroring the pattern in start_run.rs and start_spec.rs.
